snippet.title: Ultra Maze - OfficialTeaser | Mundo Gamer Showcase
snippet.description:
You are a being of pure energy and you are trapped in the ultra maze. Your mission: get out! Escape alone or compete with friends and/or AI. Choose from many options to create the gameplay you like!

Baixe a demo agora mesmo, na Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3341190/Ultra_Maze/
